description: Implementation of an undirected graph data structure with methods for node and edge management, including adding/removing nodes and edges, retrieving nodes, edges, and their properties.

classes.name: UndirectedGraph
classes.description: A struct implementing a generalized undirected graph with node and edge management functionalities.

methods.name: NewUndirectedGraph
methods.description: Creates a new undirected graph with specified self and absent edge weights.

methods.name: NewNodeID
methods.description: Generates a new unique node ID for the graph.

methods.name: AddNode
methods.description: Adds a node to the graph.

methods.name: RemoveNode
methods.description: Removes a node and its associated edges from the graph.

methods.name: SetEdge
methods.description: Adds or updates an edge between two nodes.

methods.name: RemoveEdge
methods.description: Removes an edge from the graph.

methods.name: Node
methods.description: Returns the node with the specified ID.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if a node exists in the graph.

methods.name: Nodes
methods.description: Returns all nodes in the graph.

methods.name: Edges
methods.description: Returns all edges in the graph.

methods.name: From
methods.description: Returns nodes directly reachable from a given node.

methods.name: HasEdgeBetween
methods.description: Checks if an edge exists between two nodes.

methods.name: Edge
methods.description: Returns the edge between two nodes if it exists.

methods.name: EdgeBetween
methods.description: Returns the edge between two nodes.

methods.name: Weight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the edge between two nodes.

methods.name: Degree
methods.description: Returns the degree of a node.
